steps.name: dependency-versions
pq-provider-availability
command:
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(sys.argv[1]))
import tls
from tls.pq.signature import available_pq_signers
providers=available_pq_signers(); print(json.dumps(providers,sort_keys=True))
if any(providers.get(name) != 'ok' for name in ('falcon-512','falcon-1024','ml-dsa-44')): raise RuntimeError('Required PQ provider is unavailable')

scope: Fresh Linux CPU functional regression; CUDA runner uses mock-only checks; model tests are structural, not formal proofs
falcon_provider: existing hash-checked locked provider; runtime tests execute it

skip_reasons.reason: the patch exists for Windows directory DACLs
